newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-PALLISTER BACK IN THE TREATMENT ROOM.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PALLISTER BACK IN THE TREATMENT ROOM.

text.p: Manchester United manager Alex Ferguson fears central defender Gary Pallister could spend another unhappy spell on the sidelines after sustaining a recurrence of the back injury which wrecked last season.
But Ferguson has ruled out surgery.
Pallister, who played in just six of United's last 23 premier league games last season after being hit with the problem, was forced off at half time when United thrashed Sunderland 5-0 on Saturday.
"Gary was injured after just five minutes on Saturday and we will have to monitor things closely," said Ferguson. "But he is out on Thursday for the game with Nottingham Forest.
"I just hope the injury isn't as bad as last year when it kept him out for quite a time. We will just have to see how it goes.
"But I'm not considering surgery, that would keep him out for a long time, so we are trying to find a way round that. Treatment and rest will help and hopefully he will be back quickly."
